text.p: The following are top headlines from selected Canadian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Canada pushes U.S. for support: Intense lobbying to get humanitarian mission to Zaire off the ground also aimed at UN.
- U.S. planes key for Canadians to get to Zaire: Troops, equipment must be removed quickly in order to rescue refugees.
- Papers contradict position on abuse: Ottawa claimed native school staff.
- Hundreds die in Indian crash: Saudi, Kazakhstani aircraft carrying 351 people collide outside New Delhi.
- Sharing food helps people overcome their isolation.
- Toronto baseball player Pat Hentgen wins pitching award.
- Venture fund investment soars: Capital providers poised to inject a record amount into young Canadian companies.
- Canadian Air union members demand vote: Union leaders 'won't listen to anybody'
- Limit directorships, U.S. panel urges: Canadian advocates applaud proposal.
- Beware of Sherritt, U.S. warns: Buyers in debenture issue could face wrath of Helms-Burton.
- Signs of progress in Canadian deadlock: 'High level of optimism' that a settlement can be reached by Nov. 30, compan says after union extends olive branch.
- Canada on brink of free trade deal with Chile.
